about: Mackenzie County is a specialized municipality in northwestern Alberta, covering a vast boreal territory around High Level, La Crete, and Fort Vermilion—not a city. Mennonite farming settlements, oil and forestry, and highway gateways toward the Northwest Territories share one of Alberta’s largest municipal land areas. About 13,000 people live in Mackenzie County.
